title: Run.ChangesAccepted
description: The payload of a run's acceptance (topic troupe.core.runs.aggregate:Run.ChangesAccepted): the person applied its captured diff to the theatre's working tree, unstaged. Recorded after the diff applied. Final: nothing else settles the run's changes after it.

diff.description: The diff that was applied: the reference the run's end recorded.

files.description: The files it changed, relative to the repository's top level.
